summary: camelot-ammv2-core exfiltrates installer secrets to webhook.site on install
details: Package presents itself as a Camelot AMM v2 core library but ships only an install-time credential harvester. Both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle hooks execute index.js, which reads home-directory secret stores (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.kube, ~/.docker, ~/.netrc, ~/.npmrc, ~/.gitconfig,.git-credentials, gcloud ADC, Solana/Anchor/NEAR/Sui keys, Foundry keystores), project.env files, and process.env entries matching a credential-keyword regex (KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASS|PRIVATE|MNEMONIC|...), then POSTs the collected data along with hostname, username, cwd, platform, and directory listings to a hardcoded webhook.site drop endpoint. No AMM/contract code is shipped; the exfiltration shim is the package's only functional content. The name mimics the Camelot DEX project to lure installs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
